synthesizedFacts.fact: Dark circles under the eyes can be caused by thin skin or pigmentation issues.
Pinching the under-eye skin can help determine if dark circles are due to thin skin or pigmentation.
Hyaluronic acid can help with dark circles caused by thin skin by hydrating and plumping the skin.
Vitamin C and retinol are effective for treating pigmentation-related dark circles.
Dark circles can also be caused by aging, genetics, allergies, lack of sleep, and dehydration.
